intent: Analyze system state baseline for Lenovo Legion Slim 7
detected_fault: BSOD (Win 11 issue or hardware, cannot determine)
Screen turns off when tilted down by 20-30 degrees
Intentional sleep behavior when lid is not fully closed
suggested_solution: Verify if the 'When I close lid' setting is enabled and set to sleep the machine.
Investigate the cause of the BSOD and freezes in Firefox.
Consider using a different secondary drive that requires NVMe compatibility (e.g., M.2 PCIe SSD).
Report the issue with the F5 key being used for brightness instead of volume to Lenovo support.
